articles.title: PREVIEW: Ducks Seek Fifth Straight Road Win with Visit to Blues
Mammoth look to end skid while hype for Winter Classic vs. Avalanche begins
Gauthier ‘just flowing’ during 10-game goal streak for Ducks
Rocky Mountain Meeting with the Mammoth

returning: /player": "Beckett Sennecke", "detail": "missed the past game due to illness, will play"],
away.summary: The Ducks (11-10-1) are coming off an 8-6 loss to the Blues, though Cutter Gauthier extended his goal streak to 10 games. Lukas Dostal is confirmed to start in net, while Beckett Sennecke returns after missing the previous game with an illness. Drew Helleson is scratched, Stian Solberg was recalled and could make his NHL debut, and Travis Mitchell was sent to the AHL.

out.detail: upper body injury, not expected to play

doubtful.detail: could make Avalanche debut if team plays with 11 forwards and seven defensemen

home.summary: The Avalanche (12-7-3) lost 4-1 to the Utah Mammoth on Wednesday and did not hold a morning skate. They are without Gavin Brindley, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Zachary L'Heureux, and Josh Manson due to injuries. Mike Reilly, claimed off waivers from Carolina on Sunday, could make his Avalanche debut depending on lineup construction.
